This 42-foot catamaran is fully equipped with features that ensure a relaxing and memorable experience on the beautiful waters of Southwest Florida. Our catamaran boasts comfortable bow seating perfect for sightseeing, sunbathing, and watching for dolphins on a Naples dolphin tour. The unique combined cockpit and saloon offer both outside and inside seating options, providing protection from the elements while keeping you connected to the stunning scenery.
